tagline.en_US: Organize tasks, projects, notes and time tracking in a private productivity app.

description.en_US: Super Productivity is an offline-first to-do list, time tracker, and daily planner designed for personal task management. It allows users to structure work with sub-tasks, projects, and tags, and organize them visually using timeline schedules or Kanban and Eisenhower boards. The application provides built-in time tracking with Pomodoro and Flowtime focus sessions, break reminders, and work summary exports. It also integrates with external issue trackers and supports syncing across multiple devices.
